title: Lighting WHAT 19 Autodiagnostic Fault State on BTicino MH200
summary: Empirical observation that when a lighting actuator suffers an internal autodiagnostic fault, querying its state (*#1*74##) elicits *1*19*74## immediately followed by a WHO 1001 autodiagnostic bitmask (*#1001*74*11*111110111111111111110111##). Proves that WHAT 19 is an unmapped fault status rather than 'ON'.
